تصطخبوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَخِبُوا (taṣṭaḵibū) /tasˤ.tˤa.xi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# تُصْطَخَبُوا (tuṣṭaḵabū) /tusˤ.tˤa.xa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
